identity_assessment.candidate_title: Replikation eines Kontrollierten Experiments zu Entwurfsmustern
basis: University project names same author/supervisor and preparation for RESER 2011 joint replication.
Thesis describes autumn 2010 FUB software-engineering project students; conference abstract describes one sub-replication of joint effort selected in 2010.

Java Communication Library/Decorator and Graphics Library/Abstract Factory–Composite overlap; thesis GR extension faster in alternative group (55.4 versus 77.6 minutes) matches direction in conference abstract.
Later author report explicitly builds on four workshop reports including Prechelt/Liesenberg [27] and links FUB motivation to a bachelor thesis.
limits: No explicit statement located equating this named thesis dataset with the exact 2011 conference analysis.
Thesis: 13 recruited, two incomplete excluded (11 analyzed, arithmetic); later joint report shows FUB 12 in Table 21. Different cleaning, inclusion, or cohort remains possible.
No participant-ID or complete conference-methods comparison available.
Thesis does not establish the conference claim that exactly one result is statistically significant. Directional agreement alone cannot establish identical data.
Thesis says Graphics Library ALT also uses Abstract Factory and emulates Composite; do not silently replace with a wholly pattern-free description.

methods_sample_tasks.sample: 13 computer-science students from Softwaretechnik–Softwareprojekt; two incomplete records excluded; two groups, each one PAT and one ALT program.
methods_sample_tasks.setting: home/computer, Java instead of original C++; two programs instead of four.
methods_sample_tasks.tasks: CO: add optional Hamming coding, reason about reset/IMPOSSIBLE, construct compressed/encrypted non-logging channel. GR: add plotter output device, judge whether commands produce X-shaped drawing.
methods_sample_tasks.analysis: Preliminary one-factor ANOVA, bootstrap group means; two interruption times adjusted; CO comprehension tasks timed together.
methods_sample_tasks.results: CO coding mean times 52.5 PAT vs 52.6 ALT minutes with near-perfect correctness. GR extension 77.6 PAT vs 55.4 ALT minutes with no correctness difference. GR comprehension had only one correct answer per group.

author_main_message.paraphrase: Thesis attributes the GR maintenance disadvantage to limited practical Abstract Factory familiarity; CO timing differences are negligible with slightly better correctness for PAT; Composite did not affect results. This is thesis author interpretation, not a final replication verdict.
